<!-- pr-reviewer: 9b766ec21c37a6868ab748ec5b2d4357b3d2ebd2 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- One small shared helper (`error_text.rs`, 87 lines, provenance line present); every call site passes the original string through unchanged (`&msg`, `&r.to_string()`, `&format!(..)`), so no truncation, reformatting or hiding of any diagnostic. Copy gets the same `plain` text that is displayed.
- No refusal removed: each former `colored_label`/`Label` site still renders under the same condition; the underlined, clickable refusal link in `op_page.rs` keeps its click-to-frame behaviour via `error_rich(.., true)`.
- Wrapped text is now consistent (the machines-pane "Cannot open" line used to be an unwrapped label).
- Clipboard copy is ephemeral UI, decision recorded in `docs/decisions/867-copyable-errors.md` (correct file, no `RECOMMENDED.md` edit). No snapshot PNGs, CHANGELOG, build.rs, scripts, `.github`, dependencies or process files touched. Layering respected (ui only, no components). No unwrap/expect/panic outside tests.
- Body has `Changelog:`, `Fixes #867`.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main: already up to date, no conflicts; macOS)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick` plan (ui lib, boundary, boundary_picks, theme_files), run with `--test-threads=1` | ui lib 533 passed / 0 failed / 5 ignored; boundary 3/3; boundary_picks 6/6; theme_files 14/14 |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- No structural assertion in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs` was added or changed. The three new unit tests in `error_text.rs` cover the widget (Copy button, plain text node, right-click "Copy message"); an assertion that e.g. the Post refused window exposes "Copy" for a multi-line reason would pin the wiring at a call site. The existing structural suite passes unchanged.
- The clipboard write itself is not asserted (stated in the PR body).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9b766ec21c37a6868ab748ec5b2d4357b3d2ebd2 -->
**Independent review** (second pair of eyes; the PR was only self-reviewed before). Verdict: **Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- One shared widget (`egui_app/error_text.rs`): selectable wrapped text, right-click "Copy message", plus a visible "Copy" button for multi-line or >80-char messages. Copying is ephemeral UI state (`ctx.copy_text`), so no command is needed; the decision is recorded in `docs/decisions/867-copyable-errors.md`.
- Surfaces covered: operation / setup / tool page errors, geometry-pick and stock-pick refusals, tool-number clash, the Post refused window (`post_refusal.rs`), machines pane and machine file editor refusals, "Cannot open: ..." errors, the four fixture dialogs; the status strip already had it.
- The clickable underlined refusal link keeps its click (`error_rich(..., sense_click = true)`), and plain error text stays non-editable. No snapshot PNG changes, no println/eprintln, layering intact, new module has a provenance line.

Local results (merged with main a6bd69d8, clean merge)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD crates/ui): 534 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored; the 3 new `error_text::tests` pass (Copy button for multi-line, none for a short line, context menu offers "Copy message")
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (non-blocking)
- Warning/note texts still use `ui.colored_label(inks.warn, ...)` and are not selectable: `boundary.rs:79,84,245`, `op_page.rs:134,355`. The issue asks for errors, so this is fine, but "everywhere" in the title is not literally met; a follow-up could route them through `error_text` too.
- The clipboard write itself is not asserted (the PR says so). `pages.rs` is already 1924 lines (pre-existing, only +3 here).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
